title: 1816 Prairie checked against its 1874 engraving
items: The Henderson house at 1816 Prairie is now also checked against The Land Owner's engraving of May 1874, the earliest picture of it. Its rear range now stands at the height that engraving draws, about two metres lower than before, and its south chimney rises from the side cornice up the slate roof, where both the engraving and the later photograph place it.
